title: Video by dacostamotion
description:
Here I’m sharing a bit of how the creative process behind the Realure motion came together 👀

It was a challenging project, invited by @ofeliperufino , that pushed me a lot — from motion to sound design.

I thought it was important to show the process because there was a lot of trial, adjustment, and layers behind the final result.

Aqui compartilho um pouco de como foi o processo de criação do motion da Realure 👀

Foi um projeto desafiador, chamado pelo @ofeliperufino , e que me exigiu bastante — do motion ao sound design.

Achei importante mostrar o processo porque teve muita tentativa, ajuste e camada por trás do resultado final.
